<!--

Types: feat, fix, improve, refactor, docs, chore.

Avoid implementation details such as:

Closes #100162

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where cron-driven embedded agent runs could appear completed even when the final assistant turn produced no deliverable reply, leaving the configured channel without a response or failure signal.

## Why This Change Was Made

Cron finalization now treats a delivery-requested embedded run with no final payload or synthesized text as a cron run error instead of passing it into the silent delivery path. The guard preserves intentional silent replies and message-tool source deliveries that already satisfied the target, so this does not change explicit no-reply or already-delivered flows.

## User Impact

Operators and channel users now get an observable cron failure state for empty final assistant completions instead of a dark lane where the job is marked complete but no reply reaches the destination.

## Evidence

- Added a focused regression that simulates a completed embedded run with delivery requested and no final payload; it now asserts the cron result is `error`, delivery dispatch is not attempted, and the error is surfaced.
- `pnpm test src/cron/isolated-agent/run.meta-error-status.test.ts` passed.
- `pnpm test src/cron/isolated-agent/run.meta-error-status.test.ts src/cron/isolated-agent/run.empty-delivery.test.ts` passed.
- `pnpm test src/cron/isolated-agent/run.source-delivery.test.ts src/infra/outbound/source-delivery-plan.test.ts` passed.
- `pnpm tsgo:core` passed.
- `pnpm tsgo:core:test` passed.
